definition.name: Sands of Renewal
definition.subtitle: Every horizon begins with what we carry forward.
definition.description: A reusable second-season template built from Sands of Beginnings. Choose a fresh launch window and adapt the reviewed briefs to the community's next chapter while preserving equal 5,000-XP paths and the level-10 cap. Existing Season 1 progression, claims, deliveries, and archives remain independent. This package imports only a draft; review its schedule, rewards, and item support before publication.
